saving_clause.exception_paragraph: Article XX preserved for visiting students.

articles.note: Canadian treaty exempts foreign-source maintenance/education payments to students/trainees. US-source wages not exempt under this article.

notes: AUDIT 2025-05-19: Verified Article XX (Students) against IRS Pub 901 Table 2/3 (Canada) and US-Canada Income Tax Convention Article XX. Canada's student article covers ONLY foreign-source maintenance/education payments — US-source wages from a Canadian student's on-campus job are NOT treaty-exempt. The treaty's Article XXIX saving clause is conservative — the engine treats Article XX as lost upon RA status to avoid over-claiming.
